src/praisonaiui-ts is a small TypeScript package, named praisonaiui, for rendering an aiui build site inside your own React or Next.js app. It reads the JSON manifests the build writes and gives you layout and slot components. Status You do not need this package to use PraisonAIUI. aiui run and aiui build ship their own UI inside the Python wheel, and nothing in the current UI is published to npm. The praisonaiui package on npm is version 0.1.0 (January 2026); the source in the repository is 0.2.0 and is not published. The package is not built or tested in CI. To extend the UI that aiui run serves, write a plugin against @aiui/sdk instead; see UI plugins.
Without next installed, npm run build writes the JavaScript but fails at the type-declaration step. React 18 or later is a peer dependency; Next.js 14 or later is optional at runtime.
